claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-006
Date of Incident: November 13, 2020
Time of Incident: Approximately 1615–1740 hours
Location: 7900 block of Adams Way, Anaheim, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer K. Nassiri
Badge Number: 3841
Subject: Diego Renteria, Male, 22 years old, Hispanic, shaved head, black jacket with white stripes, black shorts
Officer(s): Officer K. Nassiri, Officer D. Montoya
APD helicopter "Angel" responded
A male subject brandishing a firearm at a reporting party in a vehicle
The suspect was traveling in a gray Toyota sedan
The suspect was last seen pulling into the 7-Eleven parking lot at Beach Boulevard and Lincoln Avenue
At approximately 1619 hours, APD Officer Dahl arrived at the 7-Eleven
A male matching the suspect description walking on Lincoln Avenue just north of the parking lot
The subject, later identified as Diego Renteria, immediately fled southbound on foot upon seeing Officer Dahl
The subject was observed entering the Walmart parking lot
Officer Dahl broadcast a description of the subject: a Hispanic male with a shaved head, wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and black shorts
At approximately 1629 hours, Officer T. Ross and Officer A. Gutierrez observed the subject walking eastbound on Adams Way near Grand Avenue
Upon seeing the officers, the subject fled on foot and jumped a wall into the yard of a residence at 7944 Adams Way
The APD helicopter "Angel" responded and began establishing an aerial perimeter
Additional units set up a ground perimeter

At approximately 1656 hours, APD Sgt. J. Harmon distributed a wanted flyer identifying the subject as Renteria, who was wanted by the Buena Park Police Department in connection with a residential burglary in which a firearm was stolen
The flyer cautioned that the subject should be considered armed and dangerous
Officer Montoya and I were assigned to maintain a perimeter position in the backyard of 7914 Adams, approximately three houses east of 7896 Adams

Beginning at approximately 1700 hours, officers within the helicopter made repeated public address announcements in English and Spanish, directing the subject to exit the residence at 7896 Adams with his hands raised
The subject was observed through the windows walking up and down the stairs but made no effort to comply
At approximately 1737 hours, I observed the subject exit from the front door of 7896 Adams
The subject walked directly toward our position in the backyard of 7914 Adams
There was adequate ambient lighting from nearby streetlights, and I was able to clearly see the subject's hands and movements as he approached
The subject was carrying an object in his right hand that I believed to be a dark-colored handgun
The subject stopped approximately 20 feet from our position, raised both hands above his head, and then suddenly lowered his right hand toward his waistband
I discharged my firearm four times at the subject's center mass
The subject fell to the ground
Officer Montoya and I approached and handcuffed the subject
I observed the subject had sustained gunshot wounds to his upper torso and right arm
A tourniquet and medical bandages were applied
At approximately 1743 hours, paramedics arrived and transported the subject to UCI Medical Center where he underwent surgery and survived
A search of the immediate area revealed a black semi-automatic handgun on the ground approximately three feet from where the subject fell
The subject was wanted by the Buena Park Police Department in connection with a residential burglary in which a firearm was stolen
The subject should be considered armed and dangerous
Body-worn camera footage (Officer Nassiri, Officer Montoya)
Four (4) cartridge cases, Winchester 45 Auto
One (1) Adidas tennis shoe
One (1) pair black shorts
One (1) cellphone
Crime scene photographs (191)
Subject transported to UCIMC, underwent surgery, survived
Scene secured for investigation by OCDASAU
Officer Signature: K. Nassiri
Date of Report: November 14, 2020
